brief:
Israel's official mapping service published high-resolution satellite imagery of Gaza showing military bases and widespread destruction before removing and blurring the images, Middle East Eye reported. The Israeli service had accidentally made the detailed photographs publicly accessible for a limited period.

The incident revealed the extent of damage across Gaza through official Israeli sources, though the images were later obscured from public view.

title: Israel's mapping service briefly exposes Gaza bases and destruction
